dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Now then... which poor, unfortunate soul should I drop in on next?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to now?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Ah, perfect timing, Honorary Knight. I was just hoping for a second opinion. Would you mind helping me brainstorm a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Tell me, which of these sounds more like a stress reliever? Roasting Electro Slimes over an open fire, or freezing Hydro Slimes?

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I love the sound of an Electro Slime being blown into the air... But there's something so satisfying about the feel of a blade plunging straight through a solid block of ice.

choices.text: Why not start by freezing Hydro slimes...

response.speaker: Lohen
response.text: Oh? Now that is an inspired idea. We really must go and try that together sometime, don't you think?

choices.text: Then roast some Electro Slimes with Pyro?
